name: @kodoque1/rig
description: A small animation rig for 2D characters that react: clips, a state machine, one-shots, springs, gaze, IK. One file, no dependency, any renderer. Made to be driven by a coding agent: a definition is read back in text, without a screen.

scripts.test: node scripts/build.js --check && node test/rig.test.js && node test/esm.test.mjs && node test/cli.test.js
scripts.test:types: npx -p typescript@5 tsc --noEmit --strict --target es2020 --moduleResolution node test/types.test.ts
